tii, tertiani, tertiæ generationis, abnepotes, Gen.50.

ce, 1. Sam.3.8. & תליתא Tertiâ vice, Ezech.21.14. &

תלתי Ch. Triens,
triental mensura, Psal.80.6.
הלת Ch. Tertiare, triplicare; tertiò facere, tripartiri.
* תמרה, תם Ch.Ibi, illic. Ab Hebræo שם.

pescere. Aphel Obstupescere, atto-
nitum reddere, Dementare, Act.8.11. Lucæ 24.22.
